answer: What stops the farm is not the lantern alone but the onyx behind it and the tide that survives every appeal. Earning the standing takes 4 seasons and 120 inspections under wood watchers; forging it takes the same, per fake. Real standing in this economy rests on Radiant inlayer warrant with inlayers attestation: a warrant inlayers renew after wood audits. Copies cannot carry that weight.
